name.description: Variable name. Must not start with `KC_` unless it starts with `KC_SPI_` — only custom SPI configuration may be set.

value.description: Variable value. Stored in AWS Parameter Store rather than on the cluster record.

type.description: How the value is stored — as plain text or as a secret.

allOf.description: How the variable's value is stored. `STRING` is a plain value; `SECRET` is held in AWS Parameter Store as an encrypted parameter.
allOf.title: EnvironmentVariableType
